description: This file provides support for bidirectional (BIDI) embedding in jQuery.i18n, including functions to detect text directionality and wrap content with Unicode control characters for proper rendering of LTR and RTL languages.

methods.name: strongDirFromContent
methods.description: Determines the directionality ('ltr' or 'rtl') of the first strongly directional codepoint in a given text.

methods.name: bidi
methods.description: Wraps a string with Unicode embedding characters based on its detected directionality to ensure proper display in bidirectional contexts.
